definition: Homework is school-related work that students complete outside regular class time, and it is a common part of daily student life. In this context, it is also an activity through which parents or schools may provide learning support at home.

reasons: The packet does not define homework as “school-related work completed outside regular class time”; it only says homework is an integral part of most students’ daily life and discusses parental/scholastic homework assistance.
“Learning support at home” is only indirectly related to the packet’s mentions of parental homework assistance and scholastic homework assistance, so the definition overextends the supplied source.
The packet does not explicitly define homework as “school-related work that students complete outside regular class time,” so the “outside regular class time” component is unsupported.

While the packet supports that homework is “an integral part of most students’ daily life” and discusses parental homework assistance/involvement in learning activities at home and institution-supported homework assistance, the definition’s first sentence contains an unverified characterization (outside regular class time).
